title: DPS
paper_title: Diffusion Posterior Sampling for General Noisy Inverse Problems
core_mech: 在每个 diffusion 逆时间步，把预训练先验 score 与经 x0 估计反传的测量 likelihood gradient 相加。
core_mech_en: Approximates intractable time-dependent measurement likelihood scores ∇_{x_t} log p_t(y|x_t) via backpropagation through the Tweedie posterior mean estimate x̂_0(x_t).
input_desc: 噪声测量 y、可微前向模型 A 与预训练 diffusion score prior
input_en: Corrupted measurement y, general differentiable forward operator A(·), and pretrained unconditional score network s_θ
output_desc: 近似后验样本 x_hat ~ p(x|y)
output_en: Posterior sample x̂ ~ p(x|y) satisfying noisy linear or non-linear measurement constraints
